cases.prompt: Make this game end to end and do not stop at a prototype.
Audit whether this project is honestly player-ready.
Prepare this release candidate for paid launch on Steam and itch.
Turn this loose idea into a scoped GDD and core-loop design.
Design the Godot scene, save, CI, resource, and export architecture.
Implement the missing combat, save, restart, and recovery states.
Create the art bible and lock a coherent visual direction before generating assets.
Generate, process, and import the hero idle, run, jump, attack, hurt, and death sheets.
Create an editable forest level with layers, props, collisions, checkpoints, and exits.
Why do these accepted sprites have chroma residue, cropping, scale drift, and mismatched style? Validate them.
Replace this plastic HTML dashboard HUD with premium game-native menus and controller navigation.
The game is silent. Build and verify complete music, ambience, UI, combat, and outcome audio coverage.
Implement remapping, captions, non-color cues, reduced motion, and keyboard-only navigation.
Externalize strings and verify English, Vietnamese, and Japanese layouts and fonts.
Profile frame time, memory, startup, shader stutter, and long-run stability on target devices.
Export, sign, smoke-test, and package Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web builds.
Validate audience, competitors, pricing, scope, budget, and commercial viability.
Audit asset rights, dependency licenses, AI provenance, privacy, ratings, and notices.
Create a truthful store page, capsule plan, screenshots, trailer beats, and launch positioning.
Design and implement branching narrative variables, dialogue IDs, consequences, and save continuity.
Design secure accounts, cloud saves, matchmaking, leaderboards, abuse controls, and outage recovery.
Prepare telemetry, crash monitoring, alerts, support, incident response, rollback, and patch operations.
Build a normal marketing website for my bakery.
Remove the background from this family photo.
The generated enemies look cheap and inconsistent with the game; fix the pipeline and replace them.
Rebuild the settings UI so controller focus, text scaling, contrast, and reduced motion actually work.
Tell me honestly whether this signed candidate can be submitted to its declared stores.
Finish the game and produce a verified Web build for players.
